title: Some Apple fans are building their own ‘Hackintoshes' - Mac computers they build themselves. And they point to a weakness with Apple's computer lineup (AAPL)
text: Some Apple fans are building their own ‘Hackintoshes’ — Mac computers they build themselves. And they point to a weakness with Apple's computer lineup (AAPL) By Antonio Villas-Boas Sep 9, 2018, 10:00 am 11 pts The only way to get Apple's MacOS operating system is to buy one of Apple's own Macs. That's pretty much the way it's always been. Or at least, that's the only official way. The computer pictured above is running MacOS, but it's not a Mac.
